summary.zh: 修复独立服务器安装包中 hana CLI 无法启动的问题，并让工作台视觉能力以供应商目录为准。
summary.en: Fixes the packaged server hana CLI failing to start, and treats the provider catalog as the source of truth for vision capability in Settings.

title.zh: 独立服务器 hana CLI 可正常启动
title.en: Packaged server hana CLI starts correctly

summary.zh: install-server 布局下的 hana 命令会随安装包带上 shared/artifact-core 模块，不再因找不到 activation 而退出。
summary.en: The install-server hana command ships shared/artifact-core modules with the package and no longer exits missing activation.

sources.title: fix(server): ship artifact-core modules for packaged hana CLI

title.zh: 视觉能力以供应商目录为准
title.en: Vision capability follows the provider catalog

summary.zh: 设置里的视觉能力判断改以供应商目录为唯一来源，避免本地缓存与目录不一致。
summary.en: Settings vision capability now uses the provider catalog as the single source of truth, avoiding stale local cache mismatches.

sources.title: fix(settings): treat provider catalog as vision capability SoT
